requirement: External auditor isolation: the auditor is read-only; verified by snapshot-run-verify including untracked files. Declaring read-only mode is not isolation: a dependency carrying a lazy-initialization write path (table creation, seed data) writes to the live store on first invocation even under mode=ro. Isolation is verified by the snapshot, not by the declared mode.
